pipelines.title: Detect objects
pipelines.description: Run the primary detector over live RTP/H.264 or a governed recording range

recording_replay.launch: filesrc name=source ! qtdemux name=demux demux.video_0 ! queue ! h264parse ! nvv4l2decoder ! mux.sink_0 nvstreammux name=mux batch-size=1 width=640 height=480 live-source=false batched-push-timeout=40000 ! nvinfer name=infer ! fakesink name=results sync=false async=false

graph.launch: udpsrc name=source port=9000 caps="application/x-rtp,media=video,encoding-name=H264,payload=96,clock-rate=90000" ! rtpjitterbuffer latency=50 drop-on-latency=true ! rtph264depay ! h264parse config-interval=-1 ! video/x-h264,stream-format=byte-stream,alignment=au ! tee name=encoded encoded. ! queue leaky=downstream max-size-buffers=8 ! identity name=encoded-output ! fakesink sync=false async=false encoded. ! queue ! nvv4l2decoder ! mux.sink_0 nvstreammux name=mux batch-size=1 width=640 height=480 live-source=true batched-push-timeout=40000 ! nvinfer name=infer ! fakesink name=results sync=false async=false

pipelines.title: Detect and track objects
pipelines.description: Replay governed video through the primary detector and assign persistent tracker identities

recording_replay.launch: filesrc name=source ! qtdemux name=demux demux.video_0 ! queue ! h264parse ! nvv4l2decoder ! mux.sink_0 nvstreammux name=mux batch-size=1 width=640 height=480 live-source=false batched-push-timeout=40000 ! nvinfer name=infer ! nvtracker name=tracker ! fakesink name=results sync=false async=false
